smart scheduling

Set a goal. Dayleap plans the work for you.

Tell Dayleap what you want to achieve and by when. It finds the free time on your calendar and books every work session automatically, then keeps the plan on track as life changes.

  • Auto-scheduled sessions

    Pick a goal, hours, and a deadline, and sessions are placed into your real free time around existing events.

  • Paced by priority

    High-priority goals finish early; lower ones spread evenly all the way to the due date.

  • Re-plans automatically

    Skip or reschedule a session and the rest shifts to free time, with no manual juggling.

  • Progress at a glance

    Track completion, streaks, time left, and estimated finish date for every goal.

  • Graph analytics

    Visualize your goal and calendar data with charts and graphs right on your dashboard.

Work smarter, play harder.

* compatible for desktop only

Terms of Service

1. Using dayleap. By using dayleap you agree to these terms. You're responsible for the content you add (events, goals, notes) and for keeping your account credentials secure.

2. Your content. You own the events, goals, notes, and other content you create in dayleap. We don't claim ownership of it, and we only access it to provide the app's features, as described in our Privacy Policy.

3. Google Calendar sync. If you connect Google Calendar, dayleap reads and writes events on your behalf to keep the two calendars in sync. You can disconnect this at any time in Settings. You're responsible for reviewing synced changes on both sides.

4. Acceptable use. Don't use dayleap to store or share unlawful content, attempt to disrupt the service, or access accounts that aren't yours.

5. Availability and changes. dayleap is provided "as is." We may add, change, or remove features over time, and don't guarantee uninterrupted availability.

6. Termination. You can stop using dayleap and delete your account at any time. We may suspend or terminate access if these terms are violated.

7. Copyright. All dayleap branding, design, and code are © 2026 dayleap. All rights reserved — no part of this site may be copied, reproduced, or redistributed without permission.

8. Limitation of liability. dayleap is offered without warranties of any kind. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from use of the app.

9. Changes to these terms. We may update these terms from time to time; continued use means you accept the changes.

10. Contact. Questions about these terms can be sent to einstein1a2b@gmail.com.

Privacy Policy

1. Information we collect. When you create an account, we collect your email and basic profile info. We store the calendar events, goals, notes, checklists, and settings you create in dayleap, plus any customization choices (themes, preferences).

2. Google Calendar. If you choose to connect Google Calendar, dayleap reads your calendar list and event details (titles, times, descriptions, locations, meeting links) and writes events you create, edit, or delete in dayleap back to Google Calendar. This is used solely to keep your calendars in sync, only for calendars you select, and you can disconnect at any time to revoke access.

3. Game data. dayleap includes a small built-in platformer game; if you play it, your high scores and any unlocked cosmetics are saved to your account.

4. Notifications. If you enable browser push notifications, dayleap uses Firebase Cloud Messaging to deliver them, which stores a device-specific token. If you enable email reminders, we use your email solely to send those reminders via our email provider (Resend).

5. How we use your data. Your data is used solely to provide dayleap's features — displaying your calendar, syncing events, and sending reminders you opt into. We do not sell your data or share it with third parties for advertising.

6. Storage. Your data is stored securely with our database provider (Supabase) and dayleap is hosted on Vercel. Access tokens for connected services are stored encrypted and used only server-side to perform the syncing you request.

7. Protection of sensitive data. Some information you put into dayleap, like event details, notes, and goals, may be sensitive because it can reveal things like your location, health or medical appointments, or other personal details you choose to write down. We protect it with HTTPS/TLS encryption in transit, encryption at rest in our database, and row-level access controls so only your authenticated account can read or write your own data. We don't request or store sensitive categories like health records, government IDs, or financial account numbers as part of dayleap's core features, and any third-party processor (Firebase, Resend, Google Calendar) only receives the minimum data needed to do its job.

8. Your control. You can edit or delete your events, disconnect Google Calendar, disable notifications, or delete your account at any time. Deleting your account removes your stored data, including any connected Google account tokens.

9. Changes. We may update this policy from time to time; continued use of dayleap means you accept the changes.

10. Contact. Questions about this policy can be sent to einstein1a2b@gmail.com.

Event Alerts

One-hour-before email notifications

Turn this on to get a Dayleap email about 1 hour before each calendar event starts. Your Supabase cron job checks automatically every 2 minutes and sends each reminder only once.

Enable Event Alerts
How it works: Dayleap checks upcoming events every few minutes. If an event starts in about 60 minutes and you have alerts enabled, the Edge Function sends one email and marks that event as already notified.

Add dayleap as an app
Install it once and open it like any other app: no browser bar, works offline, one tap from your home screen or desktop.

On Mobile

  1. Open dayleap.net in your browser
  2. Tap the Share or ••• menu
  3. Tap "Add to Home Screen"
  4. Tap "Add" to confirm

On Desktop

  1. Open dayleap.net in your browser
  2. Click the three dots in the top right of the browser
  3. Select "Cast, save, and share"
  4. Press "Install page as app"
